anti_leakage: Each calendar month's multiplier is frozen before that month starts using only the preceding active portfolio months. Current-month closing prices and results cannot alter it.

closing_value.guardrail: Post-settlement attribution only; closing prices and outcomes never alter eligibility, direction, or stake.

closing_expected_monthly_stability.guardrail: Closing prices are attribution-only and cannot change frozen eligibility, direction or stake. Match outcomes are not used by this diagnostic.

multiplier_selection.selection_rule: maximum minimum cross-cost discovery closing expected profit subject to the drawdown budget
